Do NOT copy and paste the duties, specialized experience, or occupational assessment questionnaire from this announcement into your resume as that will not be considered a demonstration of your qualifications for this position. Your resume must describe your work and experience, in your own words.

To be considered minimally qualified for this position, you must demonstrate that you have the required proficiency level of competencies and experience for the respective grade level in which you are applying.

REQUIRED COMPETENCIES: Experience must be Information Technology (IT)-related; the experience may be demonstrated by paid or unpaid experience and/or completion of specific, intensive training (for example, IT certification), as appropriate.

You must have IT-related experience demonstrating each of the required competencies listed below and must meet or exceed the minimum proficiency level established for each by grade level. For more information, see Competency-Based Qualification Standard for the Information Technology Management Series, 2210.

You qualify at the GS-13 and GS-14 grade level, if you have: Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.

Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.

Decision Making - Makes sound, well-informed, and objective decisions; perceives the impact and implications of decisions; commits to action, even in uncertain situations, to accomplish organizational goals; causes change.

Information Management - Identifies a need for and knows where or how to gather information; organizes and maintains information or information management systems.

Interpersonal Skills - Shows understanding, friendliness, courtesy, tact, empathy, concern, and politeness to others; develops and maintains effective relationships with others; may include effectively dealing with individuals who are difficult, hostile, or distressed; relates well to people from varied backgrounds and different situations.

Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

Problem Solving - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations. Teamwork - Encourages and facilitates cooperation, pride, trust, and group identity; fosters commitment and team spirit; works with others to achieve goals.

Technical Competence - Uses knowledge that is acquired through formal training or on-the-job experience to perform one's job; works with, understands, and evaluates technical information related to the job; advises others on technical issues.

AND SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE: In addition to meeting the qualification requirement listed above, you must have at least one year of specialized experience at the next lower GS-grade level (or equivalent).

Specialized experience is experience that has equipped you with the particular competencies/knowledge, skills, and abilities to successfully perform the duties of the position and is typically in or related to the work of the position to be filled.

Such experience is typically gained in the IT field or through the performance of work where the primary concern is IT.

You qualify at the GS-13 grade level, if you have: EXPERIENCE: At least one (1) year of specialized experience at the GS-12 grade level (or equivalent) performing at least four (4) of the following duties: Defining technical related programs and projects; Developing technical plans, strategy and policies to support and align with organizational cybersecurity initiatives and regulatory compliance; Developing methods to monitor and measure risk, compliance, and assurance efforts; Managing the underlying technical operational processes; Advocating for changes in policy that will support new initiatives or required changes/enhancements; Consulting with customers to evaluate functional requirements and translate functional requirements into technical solutions; Overseeing the development, implementation and evaluation of solutions for cybersecurity tools integration based on systems requirements, capabilities, and constraints to ensure the design meets customers' satisfaction; OR Managing the technical planning process to ensure that developed solutions meet customer requirements.

You qualify at the GS-14 grade level, if you have: EXPERIENCE: At least one (1) year of specialized experience at the GS-13 grade level (or equivalent) performing at least four (4) of the following duties: Leading development of methods to monitor and measure risk, compliance, and assurance efforts; Reviewing needs analysis to determine opportunities for new and improved business process solutions are relevant to the organization; Reviewing technical data to ensure they meet customer requirements; Administering policy guidance to technical management, staff and users; Recommending the appropriate measures through internal and/or external product releases (alerts, advisories, etc.); Conducting risk and vulnerability assessments to protect infrastructure assets and mitigate network vulnerabilities; Providing advisory services to leadership to ensure the proper operation of technical systems throughout an organization; Providing technical expertise of current and evolving best practices in cybersecurity and to the broader stakeholder community; OR Leading partnership meetings with external stakeholders.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Time-in-Grade Requirements: Under competitive merit promotion procedures, any individual who is currently holding, or who has held within the previous 52 weeks, a General Schedule (GS) position under a non-temporary appointment in the competitive or excepted service, must meet "time-in-grade" requirements (have served 52 weeks at the next lower grade of the grade for which you are applying).

Time After Competitive Appointment: By the closing date specified in this job announcement, current Federal civilian employees must wait at least 90 days after their latest non-temporary appointment from a competitive service referral certificate before promotion, transfer, reinstatement, reassignment, or detail.

All qualification requirements, including Time-in-Grade, must be met by the closing date of this announcement. Qualification AND Time-in-Grade claims will be subject to verification.

We are currently seeking a **Treasury Manager** to join our Global Treasury team as part of the **Funding (****External & Internal Funding****)** team in Geneva.

The Program Manager plays a critical role in driving the successful execution of strategic product initiatives across the organization. The ideal candidate combines strong program management expertise with a background in product management and engineering, enabling them to navigate technical complexity, influence decision-making, and accelerate business outcomes.

s.h: What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark.
s.t:
Product & Program Leadership
Lead complex, cross-functional product and technology initiatives from concept through launch and adoption
Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to translate business objectives into executable plans and measurable outcomes
Drive alignment across stakeholders, balancing customer needs, technical constraints, and business priorities

Strategic Planning & Roadmap Execution

### Notre bureau ###
**Conti & Associés Ingénieurs SA** est un bureau d-ingénieurs spécialisé dans les techniques du bâtiment **CVSER**, implanté à **Versoix (Genève)** et **Perroy (Vaud)**.
Actifs depuis 1983, nous regroupons aujourd-hui plus de 35 collaborateurs et intervenons dans les domaines suivants :
· Chauffage, ventilation et climatisation (CVC)
· Sanitaire
· Électricité
· Régulation / MCR et automatisme du bâtiment
Nous accompagnons nos clients sur l-ensemble des phases **SIA 108**, avec une activité importante sur les phases 3, 4 et 5 : études, appels d-offres, réalisation et réception des ouvrages. Nous intervenons également en phase 6 pour le suivi de l-exploitation et l-optimisation énergétique des bâtiments.
Notre activité couvre aussi les audits et diagnostics énergétiques, la physique du bâtiment, les études de faisabilité CVSER, les CECB+, les missions GED et AMOén dans le cadre du programme éco21, ainsi que les expertises techniques CVSER pour des assurances, maîtres d-ouvrage ou dans le cadre de procédures judiciaires.
### Le poste ###
Dans le cadre du développement de notre département Sanitaire, nous recherchons un(e) **Chargé(e) de projets / Planificateur(trice) Sanitaire** capable de participer à la conception et au suivi de projets variés, de l'étude jusqu'à la réalisation.

1/ **Études et conception**
a/ Concevoir et dimensionner les installations sanitaires conformément aux normes, directives et règles de l-art applicables en Suisse.
b/ Réaliser les études des réseaux d-eau froide, eau chaude sanitaire, bouclage, eaux usées et eaux pluviales.
c/ Réaliser les calculs et dimensionnements nécessaires aux projets.
d/ Élaborer les plans, schémas de principe et détails techniques.
2/ **Plans et soumissions**
a/ Réaliser et mettre à jour les plans sanitaires sous **AutoCAD 2D**.
b/ Établir les quantitatifs et métrés nécessaires aux appels d-offres.
c/ Participer à l-élaboration des **soumissions CAN** à l-aide des outils spécifiques tels que **Plancal Nova / SNAP**.
d/ Participer à l-analyse technique des offres des entreprises.
3/ **Coordination et réalisation**
a/ Assurer la coordination technique avec les disciplines chauffage, ventilation, électricité et régulation.
b/ Participer aux séances avec les maîtres d-ouvrage, architectes, entreprises et autres mandataires.
c/ Participer au suivi de l-exécution des installations sur le terrain.
d/ Contrôler la conformité des installations avec les plans, normes et prescriptions du projet.
e/ Participer aux réceptions des installations et au suivi des réserves.
### Votre profil ###
1/ **Formation et expérience**
a/ CFC de projeteur(se) en technique du bâtiment sanitaire, technicien(ne) ES, maîtrise fédérale ou formation jugée équivalente.
b/ Expérience de plusieurs années dans un bureau d-ingénieurs, bureau d'études ou une entreprise sanitaire.
c/ Une expérience professionnelle en Suisse constitue un avantage important.
2/ **Compétences techniques**
a/ Bonne maîtrise d-**AutoCAD 2D**.
b/ Connaissance de **Plancal Nova / SNAP** et des soumissions selon le **CAN sanitaire**.
c/ Bonne connaissance des normes et prescriptions sanitaires suisses.
d/ Connaissance des prescriptions **SSIGE** et des directives techniques **Geberit**.
e/ La maîtrise de **Revit / BIM** constitue un atout.
f/ Bonne maîtrise des outils MS Office.
### Vos qualités ###

The Aviation Regulatory Project Manager performs multiple, varying, and highly complex assignments under minimal direction from a manager or senior leader.

Serves as a principal technical specialist and project manager for major regulatory, operational, and integration activities involving Unmanned Aircraft Systems, Unmanned Aircraft Traffic Management, and Advanced Air Mobility for ensuring safe and effective integration into the National Airspace System (NAS).

Applies experience and comprehensive technical knowledge of emerging aviation operations, operational practices, and regulatory requirements to conduct both regulatory and operational evaluations to support the safe integration of emerging aviation operations into the NAS.

Conducts regulatory evaluations by interpreting and assessing the applicability of existing regulations, identifying compliance requirements, and determining where emerging operational models or technologies create gaps, conflicts, or misalignments with current regulatory frameworks.

Performs operational evaluations by analyzing procedures, system interactions, workflow impacts, and safety considerations to determine how emerging aviation operations function within the NAS and to identify operational risks or procedural inconsistencies requiring mitigation.

Integrates the results of both regulatory and operational evaluations to develop technical recommendations, support rule-making activities, and inform updates to operational criteria and compliance guidance.

Possesses an understanding of new technologies and methodologies, to solve complex problems and develop improved technical processes or systems. Conducts extensive research and analysis to evaluate how new operational models, technologies, or procedures align with existing regulatory requirements.

Integrates analytical results into project deliverables that support rule-making activities, regulatory evaluations, and updates to operational criteria. Evaluates complex operational scenarios to identify gaps, conflicts, or inconsistencies in regulatory applicability, compliance requirements, or operational procedures.

Performs root-cause analysis of operational or compliance issues involving emerging aviation operations and prepares technical findings that inform regulatory updates or operational mitigations.

Uses project management principles to plan, coordinate, and execute complex regulatory and operational evaluation activities and projects involving emerging aviation operations.

Develops project plans, schedules, and milestones to guide the assessment of operational data, procedures, and system interactions; and identifies safety risks, compliance concerns, and regulatory inconsistencies requiring higher-level analysis.

Ensures that project deliverables, analytical findings, and technical recommendations meet regulatory requirements, adhere to project objectives, and align with the priorities of the major subdivision and broader organizational goals.

Monitors project progress, identifies risks or delays, and implements corrective actions to maintain schedule and quality. Tracks project performance metrics; and prepares comprehensive regulatory analyses, compliance assessments, technical reports, and operational findings as key project outputs.

Consolidates operational, regulatory, and technical information into products that support decision-making and operational integration activities. Defines, organizes, and assigns resources to accomplish large regulatory, operational, and analytical work activities. Allocates resources to accomplish large work activities within established schedules.

Works across organizational boundaries to complete complex evaluations, research activities, and support tasks within established schedules. Provides policy guidance and instruction to others, both internally and externally.

Join us and shape the future of hospitality today!
EHL's dynamic campuses form a unique network where passionate students, academics and industry experts from over 120 countries come together with a common goal: to develop and disseminate hospitality knowledge, while supporting the sector's continued growth.

The Tech Solutions department at EHL is responsible for developing, managing, and optimizing digital tools and technological platforms. It ensures system performance, data security, and the integration of new technologies to support both academic and administrative activities.

The team collaborates with various departments to design tailored solutions that meet user needs. Within Tech Solutions, the EdTech sub\-section focuses specifically on educational technologies and digital solutions that enhance teaching, learning, and the overall academic experience.

Through its work, Tech Solutions fosters innovation, operational efficiency, and a seamless digital experience across the institution.
To join our amazing team, we are looking for a candidate who is not only skilled and passionate about technology and education but also aligns with our leadership principles: transparency, accountability, collaboration, care, and experimentation.
EdTech Project Manager
The mission of the EdTech Project Manager is to lead the analysis, implementation, and continuous improvement of educational technology solutions that enhance teaching, learning, and academic operations.

Acts as a key interface between academic, business, and technology stakeholders, ensuring that EdTech solutions are effectively delivered, adopted, and aligned with EHL’s educational strategy and digital ambitions.

The role focuses on managing core educational platforms, including LMS, content management and learning experience technologies, while driving innovation through the adoption of AI and emerging technologies.

Operating as a hybrid project manager–solution enabler, the EdTech Project Manager combines strong project management with a hands\-on understanding of educational technologies, user needs, digital learning content, and change management.

Analyze educational technology and AI\-related needs and identify solutions that enhance teaching, learning, and academic operations.
Lead the implementation and management of key educational technology platforms, including LMS, content management, and learning experience solutions.
Manage projects end\-to\-end, including timelines, budgets, resources, risks, and vendor relationships, ensuring successful delivery within agreed scope.
Collaborate with academic, business, and technology stakeholders to ensure effective delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement of EdTech solutions.
Drive the adoption of AI and emerging educational technologies while ensuring alignment with institutional policies, standards, and requirements.
Provide training, guidance, and change management support to maximize user adoption and ensure value realization.
Monitor solution performance, user adoption, and stakeholder satisfaction, identifying opportunities for improvement.
Stay up to date with developments in educational technology, AI, multimedia, and digital learning content, and assess their potential value for EHL.

You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Educational Technology, or a related field; a Master’s degree is a plus.
You bring at least 5 years of experience in project management, ideally within educational technology, higher education, or a similar environment.
You have proven experience implementing and managing LMS and other educational technology platforms.
You have a strong understanding of digital learning technologies, content management, and learning experience platforms.
You have experience managing multiple projects simultaneously, working with cross\-functional teams, and coordinating internal and external stakeholders.
You have hands\-on experience with system integration, data migration, software implementation, and project management methodologies.
You have a strong understanding of digital learning interoperability and content standards, including SCORM, xAPI, cmi5, LTI, and QTI.

You are analytical, organized, and solution\-oriented, with excellent organizational and time management skills and the ability to translate business and academic needs into practical technology solutions.
You are an effective communicator and collaborative team player, able to build strong relationships with stakeholders, adapt to changing priorities, and work effectively in an agile, cross\-functional environment.

Le rôle nécessite une forte capacité de structuration, de coordination et de communication avec des interlocuteurs IT, métiers et fonctions support.

Cadrage et planification du portefeuille projets

Pilotage opérationnel des projets GRC

Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) is a single-threaded organization that owns the end-to-end customer experience for heavy and bulky products, from supply chain and fulfillment through transportation, last mile delivery, and post-purchase resolution. AMXL currently operates across North America, Europe, Japan, and is expanding into emerging markets.

Within AMXL, the CX and Growth org is a centralized, worldwide team organized across five pillars designed to ensure that every customer who purchases a large, high-value product receives a reliable experience.
The Execution Excellence pillar is where planning meets the customer. It houses two complementary teams: our AMXL Operations Center and our AMXL Proactive Execution program.

These teams serve as the real-time network execution backbone, translating strategic decisions into daily network performance across our end-to-end network and also as the mechanism that identifies delivery failures before they become visible to the customer and intervenes proactively to save the delivery or manage the recovery directly with the customer.

Together, these teams form a closed loop: detect upstream, prevent where possible, intervene proactively where not, and feed root causes back so defects are resolved at the source.
We are seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead the integration and transformation of this combined organization. This is not a steady-state program management role. The program strategy is being built.

You will inherit a consolidation in progress and own the lifecycle of making it work: assessing what the combined org should look like, defining how we measure success, building the mechanisms that make it sustainable, and driving the hard conversations required to get there.

You will use process lifecycle evaluation methodologies to categorize the team's portfolio (automate, simplify, reallocate, or deprecate), and build automation roadmaps in partnership with technical teams.
This role requires someone who can operate in high ambiguity, make trade-offs between short-term operational needs and long-term strategic goals, and communicate persuasively across teams. The right candidate sees automation and AI as something they use today, not something they plan to use later, and will set the standard for how this team uses technology to scale impact without scaling headcount.

· Define the operating model for the combined organization: org design, process rationalization, scope definition, and mechanisms that make it self-sustaining.
· Build the process lifecycle evaluation framework, determining which workflows to automate, simplify, reallocate, or retire, and manage the pipeline of new use cases from scoping through launch.
· Own the automation roadmap in partnership with data science, engineering, and technology teams, establishing accountability mechanisms with clear timelines for every manual process.
· Drive cross-functional stakeholder alignment across supply chain, quality, and operations, navigating complex organizational dynamics and building trust where needed.
· Scale this capability into new geographies by adapting the operating model to local carrier ecosystems, regulatory environments, and workforce availability.
A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing program metrics dashboards, identifying areas that need attention, and preparing a status narrative for a director-level review. By mid-morning you are facilitating a working session with partners to align on priorities for the quarter.

After lunch you dive into data to validate assumptions behind a proposed solution, then draft a decision document that frames trade-offs for leadership. You close the day mentoring a newer program manager and connecting with cross-regional counterparts to keep workstreams on track.

· **Optimize**: when a customer does need support, ensure AMXL stakeholders have the tools, resources, policies, and protocols to deliver a perfect experience.
The operations center translates strategic decisions into daily network performance. The proactive execution team ensures that when defects occur, customers are protected through early intervention. The Sr. Program Manager will be the link that makes both teams operate as one system.

Impecto Consulting ist eine Beratung aus Düsseldorf für Industrieunternehmen mit gewachsenen Prozess- und Systemlandschaften.

Unser Thema ist Produktinformation von der Anforderung bis zum Service: die Prozesse und Systeme, die Informationen aus Entwicklung und Konstruktion durchgängig bis in Dokumentation und Service tragen – PLM, ALM, ERP, Redaktionssysteme, Verwaltungsschale.

Wir bereiten Vorhaben so auf, dass sie entschieden werden können, und steuern anschließend die Umsetzung. Die Einführung der Systeme übernehmen die Anbieter; wir arbeiten herstellerneutral. Wir sind ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen zur Geschäftsführung.
Aufgaben
Du leitest bei unseren Kunden die Umsetzung von Vorhaben rund um Produktinformation und die Systeme, in denen sie entsteht und genutzt wird – bei Konzernen ebenso wie im Mittelstand. Für den Kunden bist du der Ansprechpartner für Planung, Fortschritt und Steuerung des Projekts. Die fachliche Lösung – Konzept, Datenarchitektur, Semantik – gestaltest du gemeinsam mit unseren Senior Consultants.
Zwei Schwerpunkte prägen unsere Projekte derzeit. In der technischen Dokumentation geht es um die Ablösung von Redaktionssystemen und Dokumentations-Toolchains und ihre Anbindung an PLM und SAP, damit Informationen aus Konstruktion und ERP durchgängig in Anleitungen, Ersatzteilkataloge und Serviceunterlagen fließen.
